name: Coyote Starrk

power.name: Los Lobos
power.notes: Soul split into himself and Lilynette; unifies into twin guns firing Cero Metralleta and exploding spirit wolves.

powerSteps.title: Resurrección
powerSteps.name: Los Lobos
powerSteps.desc: Fuses with Lilynette to manifest twin dual flintlocks that fire up to a thousand blue Cero blasts simultaneously.

powerSteps.title: Ultimate Art
powerSteps.name: Soul Pack Wolves
powerSteps.desc: Separates pieces of his own soul into a pack of spirit wolves that chase targets down and detonate on impact.

blurb: The Primera Espada whose spiritual loneliness drove him to divide his soul into two separate entities. Despite preferring an afternoon nap over war, his rapid-fire Cero guns overwhelm captain-class duels.

name: Baraggan Louisenbairn
kanji: バラガン・ルイゼンバーン

power.name: Arrogante
power.notes: Commands senescence and absolute decay (Respira), rotting all physical, spiritual, and Kido matter into dust upon touch.

powerSteps.title: Resurrección
powerSteps.name: Arrogante & Respira
powerSteps.desc: Transforms into a crowned skeletal monarch cloaked in decaying smoke that ages bones, buildings, and spells to ash instantly.

powerSteps.title: Weapon
powerSteps.name: Gran Caida
powerSteps.desc: Swings a gargantuan black battle axe that radiates intense aging miasma with every sweeping chop.

blurb: The ancient monarch who ruled over Hueco Mundo from an open-air bone throne before Aizen usurped his reign. His miasma of time rots weapons, flesh, and energy barriers into dust upon mere proximity.

name: Tier Harribel

power.name: Tiburón
power.notes: Commands boiling aquatic torrents and massive tidal waves through a shark-fin broadsword.

powerSteps.title: Resurrección
powerSteps.name: Tiburón & Cascata
powerSteps.desc: Adopts shark-carapace armor and commands massive boiling tidal waves capable of submerging cityscapes in flash floods.

powerSteps.title: Thermal Art
powerSteps.name: Hirviendo

blurb: The composed third Espada whose personal philosophy centers on sacrifice and protecting her loyal Fracciones. Following Aizen's defeat, she became the undisputed guardian and sovereign of Hueco Mundo.

name: Ulquiorra Cifer
kanji: ウルキオラ・シファー

power.notes: The only Espada to achieve Segunda Etapa; generates lightning lances that obliterate horizons.

powerSteps.title: First Release
powerSteps.name: Murciélago

powerSteps.name: Segunda Etapa

powerSteps.title: Ultimate Weapon

powerSteps.desc: Materializes a crackling javelin of green spiritual lightning whose detonation creates atomic mushroom clouds on the horizon.

blurb: The nihilistic fourth Espada who questioned the intangible concept of the human heart while battling Ichigo Kurosaki. His secret Segunda Etapa unleashes lightning spears with apocalyptic destructive force.

blurb: A towering sadist obsessed with battle who boasted the thickest Hierro skin in the Arrancar army. He yearned to perish in combat before hitting the floor, meeting his match against Kenpachi Zaraki.

powerSteps.title: Finisher
